answer: The zephyr schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the hollow checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 80 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An copycat wanting 48 effective identities must lock that capital for 80 epochs and keep it locked through every oasis audit. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
